measured_by: src/test/java/com/masson/cruciblecraft/scale/ScaleWorkloadBoundTest.java (JUnit, deterministic exact counts; pipe schedule tests are pure JVM, multiblock counters use a fake StructureAccess)

scenario_value_derivation.pipes_due_per_tick_max: STATIC_INFERENCE from the 5-tick position-phased schedule (PipeTransferPhase): pipes_total / 5 exactly; asserted per tick by ScaleWorkloadBoundTest.
scenario_value_derivation.route_discovery_visited_max: STATIC_INFERENCE worst case: every pipe in the scenario visited once (pipes_total); far below the 32768 traversal cap.
scenario_value_derivation.route_cache_entries_per_pipe_max: The per-pipe route cache cap (256) is identical in every scenario; the scenario never raises it.
scenario_value_derivation.port_scan_ops_max: 2 ops per port (hasChunkAt + getBlockEntity) x the largest port count among the scenario's declared structures: tank_3x3x3 has 25 ports (50) for small; distillation_tower has 80 ports (160) for target/stress.
scenario_value_derivation.structure_validation_ops_max: 2 ops per position (isLoaded + blockState) x the largest structure: tank_3x3x3 27 positions (54) for small; distillation_tower 81 positions (162) for target/stress.
scenario_value_derivation.cover_configuration_payload_bytes_max: Worst-case cover configuration packet bound (CoverConfigurationPayload.MAX_ENCODED_BYTES), identical across scenarios.

small.evidence: GameTest suite t24Small* (5 tests incl. the mutation gate) in CrucibleCraftGameTests.java; the scenario is built from the declared manifest counts and runs warmup 200 + sampling 1200 ticks to a deterministic integer summary with conservation assertions. No wall-clock gate.

method.timing_error_bar: not applicable - conservation and bounded-count assertions, no wall-clock gate
